title: The Magic of Oz
author: L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum
longDescription: Frank Baum is a fantasy novel published in 1919. When a Munchkin boy named Kiki Aru discovers a powerful transformation spell, he teams with the exiled Nome King Ruggedo to conquer Oz.

authorInfo.bio: L. Frank (Lyman Frank) Baum (1856–1919) is the author of The Magic of Oz. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
